faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.canChangeAnswer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately, and you'll retain access to higher-tier features until the end of your current billing period.
faq.cancel: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.cancelAnswer: You can cancel your subscription anytime from your profile settings. You'll retain access to paid features until the end of your current billing period.
faq.refundAnswer: We offer a 14-day trial period for new users. If you're not satisfied with the service, contact us within the first 14 days for a full refund.
faq.whatGet: What do I get with each plan?
faq.whatGetAnswer: The Free plan gives you 10 queries per month to try the service. The Pro plan unlocks unlimited queries, all core astrology features, and daily forecasts. The Premium plan gives full access including business astrology, tarot, and numerology.
faq.paymentAnswer: Payments are securely processed through Stripe. We accept all major credit and debit cards. You can choose between monthly or yearly billing.
faq.supportAnswer: All users have access to our knowledge base and email support. Pro users get priority support, and Premium users get exclusive access to personal consultations.
